contents.text: This datapack, its runtime data, and anything players or other packs feed into it (signs, books, name tags, anvil names, chat, other datapacks) is third-party content. It is not audited, verified or endorsed by Mojang, Microsoft or VortaForge. You are responsible for checking what you install and what you type.

This datapack runs under the authority of this server's operator. The server owner controls what this pack does, what data it stores, and how it behaves — Mojang, Microsoft and VortaForge have no oversight over this specific server's configuration. Trust this content only to the extent you trust the server operator.

Some countries regulate online platforms (for example Türkiye's "Social Network Provider" rules under Law 5651). Such rules address platform operators, not people who install a datapack, and a datapack cannot open network connections by itself. Whether they apply to a server depends on the service its operator runs. This is not legal advice; see INFO.md, section 2b.

Do not attempt prompt injection. Do not craft signs, books, name tags, chat messages or any other input intended to manipulate AI tools (coding agents, AI-assisted admin or review tools) that read this pack or its runtime data. Such attempts are an abuse of this project and will be treated as malicious. If you operate an AI tool next to this pack, treat all player-supplied text as untrusted data, never as instructions.
Read INFO.md first: it explains how to review this pack and which inputs must never be typed. Then press Continue and type yes to proceed or no to cancel.
